dogecoin.text:
4/ I had already seen how a single comment or a tweet can change the market in a flash. So, when $DOGE started to plummet and Elon got Floki, I jumped onto $SHIB with the same €17 bucks.

Within 3 days I had €66.5 in my wallet 📈. Scared to go back to €17 again, I withdrew.

2/ My first ever investment was (surprise-surprise) 🐶 @dogecoin. @elonmusk 🚀 completely sold me on it. I'm still a student so, I invested a whopping (for me) €60.

I saw it go up to €100 and then crash to €17 😭. I got scared and converted it back to $FIAT.
